brief: Holds the five rules a Petri net is judged by: arcs join a place and a transition, transitions have inputs and outputs, places can be marked, transitions can fire.
detail: Check takes the rule graph of a net (AsRuleGraph) and answers the findings. A net asks for this through its own GovernanceFindings, so a rule set is built by hand only to add a rule of your own or to run the rules on a graph. The last two rules are structural: a place empty forever and a transition starved at birth, not liveness in the full sense.
